📸Content Concept

🎬How to Film It
Before & After tired-looking skin → 3 steps
Hook
"You look so tired.""No, I'm not.""It's my dark circles and my dull, dry skin."Macro close-up where your dark circles and dull, dry skin show in the same frame. Bare skin, no filter. Say the first line flat, then cut yourself off and correct it.
Problem
"That's why I look exhausted even after a full night's sleep."Stay on the same close-up. Gently pull the under-eye to show the texture.
Solution
"There are ONLY 3 steps."
  1. Reedle Shot 100 → micro Cica Reedle spicules smooth rough texture and help everything after it absorb better. Pump it on and pat it in
  2. ⭐ Eye Lifter → 12,000 micro-vibrations per minute push the formula into the under-eye for brighter, firmer-looking eyes. Glide the tip under each eye, sound on
  3. ⭐ Capsule Cream → Korean wild ginseng PDRN capsules burst fresh for dewy, plump, glowing skin. Dot it on, press to burst, then spread it with the Eye Lifter tip
Proof
"AFTER"Right after the routine, same spot as the hook. Turn your face to the light so the glow shows.
Close
⭐ Hold the box up with the pouch in frame. "My VT best sellers in one gift box. Available on YesStyle."

Hook on the problem first, the 3 steps in macro, same angle for the after, end on the box in your hands

✅Filming Rules
  • Open on dark circles and dull, dry skin in one close-up, no filter.
  • Reedle Shot goes on before the Eye Lifter.
  • The pouch shows up at least once.
  • Eye Lifter in macro, sound on.
  • Burst the capsules on camera.
  • Hands in frame for every product.
  • Say "available on YesStyle", link in bio.
  • 20 seconds or longer.
  • Post in December.
